description: The pie chart, titled "Task Type," illustrates the distribution of tasks performed by Agency B in the context of developing story case studies on generative AI's use in journalism. The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each representing a different task type with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored red, represents "Article generation," which accounts for 82.9% of the tasks. The second segment, in blue, corresponds to "Article editing," making up 14.6% of the total. The smallest segment, colored yellow, indicates "Headline generation," contributing 2.4% to the overall distribution. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of article generation, with the other two tasks comprising a much smaller portion of the workload.
